purpose: Mechanically complete the frozen V2 annual signal table through consumed 2021 and extend the unchanged rule to the fully mature 2026 YTD cohort. This is reporting and temporal rollforward only, not optimization or a new strategy search.

mother: signal open <= -1% versus the previous coordinate close
signal low is below the prior five-session low
signal turnover is at least its prior-20 mean
signal close is at or above the prior completed-session high
signal close location is at least 70%
signal close is not at the upper price limit
frozen_signal.incremental_v2_rule: same completed-session frozen mother-signal count >= 2 independent symbols
frozen_signal.cooldown: more than 20 global market sessions since the same symbol's preceding mother signal

frozen_execution.entry: first legal non-limit-up open in signal+1 through signal+3
frozen_execution.profit_target: +10% from coordinate entry, evaluated only after the entry session
frozen_execution.time_stop: H20 decision followed by the first legal sellable open

historical_summary.2021_disclosure: The chart-rule formation consumed 2021. Its row is descriptive consumed history and is not validation evidence.

required: registered CY-033 raw detector/execution projection is row-identical to the frozen coordinate daily source over both years
raw detector identities and signal fields match the frozen yearly raw candidates
same-day cluster-selected identities match the frozen yearly selected candidates
replayed status, dates, prices, reason, holding sessions and returns match frozen outcomes

mature_2026_scope.maturity_reason: worst-case T+3 entry plus H20 decision plus the next legal-open session

prohibitions: no threshold, subset, ranking, target, horizon, stop, cost or execution change
no use of 2026 outcomes to form identities or the maturity cutoff
no rescue for missing, invalid, suspended, limit-blocked or coordinate-lineage cases
no registry or prior artifact modification
no live, sizing or deployment claim
